Introduction

SEVENTOEIGHT is a six-member project boy group under TEN Entertainment. The group was formed through SBS M’s reality survival show SCOOL and debuted on July 28, 2025, with the single album "SevenToEight".

On July 1, 2024, TEN Entertainment released a teaser for its upcoming audition program SCOOL, announcing an open audition period from July 1 to July 14. SCOOL premiered on September 28, 2024, and concluded on November 30. The final lineup consisted of Chiwon (1st), D'om (2nd), M (3rd), Kyojun (4th), Jagger (5th), Exxi (6th), and Park Jin Woo (7th). On June 20, 2025, TEN Entertainment confirmed that Park Jin Woo had departed from SEVENTOEIGHT prior to debut.

On July 1, 2025, TEN Entertainment officially announced that SEVENTOEIGHT would debut on July 28, 2025, with their first single album SevenToEight. Ahead of their debut, the group released a pre-release digital single titled "PDSR (Please Don’t Stop the Rain)" on July 15.
